title: Reflow without horizontal overflow at every baseline breakpoint
asA: user on a small phone, a tablet, or a desktop
iWant: every screen to fit my viewport and reorganise sensibly
soThat: I never scroll sideways or squint at scaled-down desktop layouts

acceptanceCriteria.description: No declared route produces page-level horizontal overflow at viewport widths 360, 768, 1024, or 1440.
acceptanceCriteria.then: document scroll width does not exceed viewport width

acceptanceCriteria.description: Layout reorganises across breakpoints (stacking, column changes, navigation collapse) rather than uniformly scaling desktop layout down.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a route with multi-column desktop layout
acceptanceCriteria.then: columns stack or reorganise; content is not proportionally shrunk

acceptanceCriteria.description: Images declare intrinsic dimensions or aspect-ratio, render within their containers, and never force layout shift or overflow.
acceptanceCriteria.then: no layout shift from late image sizing and no container overflow

acceptanceCriteria.description: Data tables below 768 either adopt the card layout or scroll inside an explicitly scoped container; the page itself never scrolls horizontally.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a route containing a data table
acceptanceCriteria.then: the table is card-formatted or contained in its own scroll region

acceptanceCriteria.description: Type scales fluidly between breakpoints per the typography tokens; no text is clipped or truncated by reflow at any baseline width.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the viewport is resized across the baseline range
acceptanceCriteria.then: text wraps or scales without clipping or unintended truncation

acceptanceCriteria.description: Interactive controls remain at or above the minimum target size at every breakpoint; touch targets do not shrink below 24x24 on small viewports.
acceptanceCriteria.then: its target area is at least 24x24 CSS pixels
